name: tabs
description: A set of panels where one is shown at a time, picked by a row of tabs. Or, with links, a row of tabs for page navigation.

props.value: The selected tab. React: set it to control the tabs.
props.defaultValue: React: the first selected tab. The web component uses the value attribute, or the first enabled tab.
props.onValueChange: React: called with the new value when a user selects a tab. Web component: an op-tabs-change event with event.detail.value.

props.size: small or large. Adds tabs__list--small or tabs__list--large, which sizes every tab in the list.
props.asNav: React: render <nav class="tabs"> around the list for Tabs.Link, with no Tabs.Root. Plain HTML: <nav class="tabs"><div class="tabs__list">.

props.disabled: Skipped by arrow keys and clicks.
Adds tabs__tab--disabled and takes it out of the tab order.

modifiers.tabs__list--small: Every tab in the list is shorter, with less padding and smaller text
modifiers.tabs__list--large: Every tab in the list is taller, with more padding and a thicker indicator
modifiers.tabs__tab--active: The selected tab, or the link for the current page
modifiers.tabs__tab--disabled: A tab that cannot be selected

customPropertiesNote: Border and shadow values are box shadows. Use var(--op-border-none) to draw nothing.

tabs__list.--op-tabs-list-border-color: Color of the line under the tabs

tabs__tab.--op-tabs-tab-gap: Space between items inside the tab, like an icon and its label
tabs__tab.--op-tabs-tab-color-active: Text color when active or hovered
tabs__tab.--op-tabs-tab-indicator-color: Color of the active tab's line
tabs__tab.--op-tabs-tab-indicator-size: Thickness of the active tab's line

keyboard.ArrowRight or ArrowDown: Select the next enabled tab, wrapping to the first
keyboard.ArrowLeft or ArrowUp: Select the previous enabled tab, wrapping to the last
